meta.matching: Normalise: lowercase, strip accents and punctuation, & -> and, + -> plus, # -> sharp; drop a leading "the"; then also try with any strip word removed from the end. Match against answer or any alias. Fallbacks: per-prompt prefixes removed from the start (Mega Charizard), simple plurals (groups -> group), git subcommand flags ignored (stash pop -> stash). Keyboard shortcuts use their own normaliser (shortcut_norm.py): modifier synonyms and order unified (Control/Ctrl, Command/Cmd/⌘, Option/Alt), punctuation keys kept distinct (Ctrl+- vs Ctrl+/), and a Cmd form is accepted for any Ctrl shortcut. Mathematicians also match by surname or first+last name (surname goes to the most familiar holder).
meta.rarity: Bit is hand-picked; two curated Megabyte answers per prompt. Kilobyte is the 85-point Deep Cut tier and targets 15% of valid answers. The remaining pool targets 20% Nibble and assigns the rest Byte by familiarity.
